cells.comment: Run autofocus — moves stage in Z to find sharpest focus
cells.code:
best_pos = cam.autofocus()
print('Best focus position:', best_pos)

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
img = cam.capture()
plt.imshow(img, cmap='gray')
plt.title('In focus')
plt.show()

cells.comment: Full workflow: light on → autofocus → capture → light off
cells.code:
light.toggle()                    # light on
best_pos = cam.autofocus()        # find focus
print('Focus Z:', best_pos[2])
cam.capture(path='~/captures/focused.png')
light.toggle()                    # light off
